name: dext
description: Connect Dext Precision to MyHub via the myHub-hosted Dext MCP gateway. Access client health scores, alert levels, and activity statistics across your practice — all with a static API token.

connection.instructions: In Dext Precision, go to Practice Settings → Data Health → API Tokens → Create token. Copy the token value shown (it is only displayed once) and paste it below.

fields.name: DEXT_API_TOKEN
fields.label: Dext API Token
fields.helpText: Found in Dext Precision under Practice Settings → Data Health → API Tokens. The token is only shown once on creation — store it securely.
